lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Are you free?
Yeah.
What's up?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: There's something on my mind.
What is it?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Viper told me my messages are too formal.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: So I want to try changing the way I type.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: What could I do to sound less formal?
Want to practice talking more casually today?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: What should I do?
Try adding "haha" to your messages.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Haha?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Come to think of it, in some of the messages I've received,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I see that at the end of a sentence sometimes when it's not even funny.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I don't understand why it's there.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Aren't you supposed to use it when you laugh?
People use it to make their messages sound less serious.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: And it works?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Just by adding "haha"?
Yeah, you can use it pretty much anywhere haha

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Anywhere? Haha

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Did I do that right?
Yep, that was it

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I think I get what you're saying.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: It's still a bit foreign to me, though, so it'll take me some time to get used to it.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I suppose I need more practice.
You don't have to force yourself to use it.
A lot of people don't.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I may not use it often,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: but I'll try to practice a bit more.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Wait

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I should've used it just now, huh?
Sounds like you're starting to get a feel for it already haha

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I still feel like I'm just copying when you use it, though.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Next time I text you,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I'll be sure to use it first.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: This is something I can practice on my own.
I'm looking forward to it hahaha

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Oh, you can add more "ha"s?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I'll keep that in mind.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Anyway, I'll text you again later.
